$comment: Copy to <your project>/.claude/deploy.config.json and edit. This example mirrors JerseyOps; every value is project-specific. Omit a key to accept the plugin's built-in default (see hooks/architect-review-gate.sh and the skills).

gate.$comment: Drives the push gate. lineThreshold = counted (added+deleted) lines since the last review that force one. riskyPaths ADDS to the built-in always-review paths (API/route handlers, data layer, migrations, schema, middleware, anything named for auth or money; see hooks/architect-review-gate.sh); a touched file matching either list forces review at any size. riskyPatterns ADDS to the built-in code patterns matched against added lines (sql.raw, eval/exec, live keys, it.skip/.only, DROP/TRUNCATE, eslint-disable/@ts-ignore). Set defaultRiskyPaths or defaultRiskyPatterns to false to drop a built-in list. riskyPaths/uncounted are ERE fragments (anchored for you: riskyPaths in ^(...), uncounted in (...)); uncounted replaces its default.

commit.$comment: types the commit skill may use; attribution appended to every commit body.

review.$comment: rulebook = the file the architect reads as this project's law (its Key Concepts / Coding Conventions). Beyond the universal blockers the skill always enforces, the architect blocks on violations of THIS file.

test.$comment: command = full test run for this change. The skill prefers the project's own /test skill if one exists; this is the fallback. baseline = ref whose failures are pre-existing (don't fail the gate).

build.$comment: Typecheck + build of the COMMITTED tree. envFile is copied in as .env.local for a production-faithful build; omit if not needed.

migrate.$comment: Runs only when the commit touches schema/migration paths. e2e first, then production from the committed tree. statusCommand must report pending:0. Omit this whole block for projects without migrations.

deploy.$comment: productionBranch is the branch whose push deploys (the gate watches it). provider + the ids drive Phase 6 confirmation via the Vercel MCP tools.

changelog.$comment: path = file to append one entry per deploy. Omit to skip Phase 7.
